global_contract.htf_join_rule: as-of backward join on HTF available_at; no forward fill across unavailable future closes
global_contract.boolean_policy: prefer continuous measures; retain booleans only for irreducible event-state semantics

common_dependencies.ATR: causal trailing ATR from completed bars only
common_dependencies.trailing_statistics: rolling/expanding values ending at or before decision timestamp
common_dependencies.swing_structure: confirmed only using bars available by decision timestamp
